name: Knight Club
body:
Aura strong abjuration; CL 15; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 32,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

This +1 club inflicts an extra 1d6 points of damage when used against opponents wearing metal armor. If used against a mounted opponent in metal armor, a successful hit forces the target to make a Ride check (DC 10 + damage dealt) or be knocked from the saddle. Furthermore, when it lands a critical hit on a target wearing metal armor, that target, whether mounted or not, must make a Fortitude save (DC 10+ damage dealt) or be staggered for 1 round.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells repel metal or stone, bull’s strength; Cost 16,150 gp
